en.hubeali:
Ibn Mahboub, from Wahab Bin Abd Rabbihi, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who had a mother of his child for him, so he married her to a man, so she gave birth to a boy. Then the man died. So she returned to her master. Is it for him that he copulates with her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would observe the waiting period from the husband, of four months and ten days, then he can copulate with her by the ownership, without a marriage’.
